description: This file is a shell script used for testing the interaction between Git and SVN, specifically focusing on the effects of 'git svn reset' on caches, merge commits, and repository history. It includes commands for setting up SVN repositories, performing checkouts, and verifying merge behaviors after resets.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting a successful execution with specific setup and verification steps.

methods.name: git svn init
methods.description: Initializes a Git repository to track a Subversion repository using standard SVN layout.

methods.name: git svn fetch
methods.description: Fetches SVN revisions into the Git repository.

methods.name: git svn reset
methods.description: Resets SVN tracking to a specified revision.

methods.name: git reset --hard
methods.description: Resets the current branch to a specific state, discarding changes.

methods.name: git cat-file -p
methods.description: Displays the internal information about a commit or object in Git, used here to verify parent commits.
